definitions.explanation: The fee charged for staying overnight at a hotel, inn, or other lodging facility.

examples.japanese: {宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれています→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Breakfast is included in the accommodation fee.

examples.japanese: {宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1{泊|ぱく}1{万円|まんえん}だ。
examples.english: The accommodation fee is 10,000 yen per night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Accommodation fees go up during the busy season.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧ (lodging, staying overnight) + ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (fee).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}→宿泊費：25963_shukuhakuhi⟧: accommodation cost/expense
- {室料|しつりょう}: room charge
- {部屋代|へやだい}: room rate (colloquial)

INCLUSIONS/EXCLUSIONS:
- ⟦{素泊|すど}まり→素泊まり：07048_sudomari⟧: room only (no meals)
- ⟦{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き→朝食付き：07826_choushokutsuki⟧: with breakfast
- {二食付|にしょくつ}き: with two meals (dinner and breakfast)
- ⟦{夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き→夕食付き：30782_yuushokutsuki⟧: with dinner

RELATED WORDS:
- {宿泊税|しゅくはくぜい}: accommodation tax
- ⟦サービス{料|りょう}→サービス料：27929_saabisuryou⟧: service charge
- {入湯税|にゅうとうぜい}: bathing tax (hot spring areas)

PRICING MODELS:
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧: per person
- {一部屋|ひとへや}⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧: per room
- 1{泊|ぱく}: per night
